responsibility: This target configuration header supplies the Linux-specific NDS32 driver and ABI settings. It defines the Linux ABI flag, C predefines, dynamic linker path construction with endianness and floating ABI suffixes, PIE and linker specs, base C type choices, and the synthetic HAVE_sync_compare_and_swap* feature macros needed because atomic sync operations are provided through libraries rather than direct RTL patterns, making it the Linux companion to the generic ELF target headers.
